$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/currency.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). Office only (W2b schema wave 49/57, B-W2b-369): apps/factory-api's currencies module (B-W2b-389) writes them through command(), the daily ECB job in the tenant's system context (through the gateway, IntegrationProvider ECB). The floor and portal or link sessions read and write nothing here: a document carries its own rate. The …_tax_currency_w2b_guards triggers hold the rules. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

Currency.about: Finance switches the currencies a company's documents may be in on and off (the base currency stays on); every money screen reads them. Switched off, never deleted.

ExchangeRate.about: The daily ECB job records the reference rates of a day (never changed); finance types a manual override of a day, corrects it, or removes it to fall back to the ECB's. Documents copy the rate they use.
